title: Flat 4B
description: Retired judge Anand Swaminathan is discovered deceased in locked Flat 4B with the heating at maximum. Untangle the altered time of death and poisoned crossword.

assets.altText: Locked apartment living room with armchair, folded morning paper, and digital thermostat set high
Emergency dispatch 911 tape placed by neighbor Kavya at 01:14 AM

sections.title: Section 1: The Locked Door
sections.narrative: At 01:25 AM, police were called to Flat 4B. The reinforced brass lock was turned from the outside, requiring the master key.

questions.prompt: True or False: The front door lock of Flat 4B had been locked from the outside with a physical latch key.

hints.hintText: The latch cylinder had no internal thumbturn engaged.

sections.title: Section 2: The Crossword
sections.narrative: Beside the judge's armchair, a newspaper crossword was left open. One answer was filled in with distinct handwriting and dark blue ink.

questions.prompt: What six-letter clue was written for 14-Across describing an excessive medication dose: '______'?

hints.hintText: The opposite of weak, describing the fatal concentration.

sections.title: Section 3: The Thermostat Request
sections.narrative: The apartment was stiflingly hot upon entry. The digital thermostat log shows the temperature was raised from 20C to 34C at 20:30 PM.

questions.prompt: Why was Flat 4B's digital thermostat deliberately overridden to maximum heat?

options.optionText: To trigger the apartment sprinkler system
To accelerate body temperature decay and mask the true time of death
To destroy photographic evidence on the desk
To force the victim to open the balcony window

hints.hintText: High ambient heat distorts forensic algor mortis calculations.

sections.title: Section 4: The Medical Chart
sections.narrative: A medical prescription slip on the bedside nightstand records cardiac drops prescribed by Dr. Meera Rao.

questions.prompt: Decipher the coded pharmaceutical warning on the chart: 'READ FIRST LETTERS: D-O-S-E'

hints.hintText: The four letters spelling the measured quantity.

sections.title: Section 5: Kavya's Voicemail
sections.narrative: Neighbor Kavya called emergency services reporting a visitor leaving the flat in haste late that evening.

questions.prompt: Listen to the emergency 911 dispatch tape. What relative does Kavya report seeing locking the apartment door?

metadata.transcript: I heard footsteps rushing down the stairwell. I opened my peephole and saw his daughter Meera locking Flat 4B from the outside with her duplicate key.

hints.hintText: The family member who also served as his personal physician.

clues.title: Altered Cardiac Medication Chart
clues.clueText: Dr. Meera Rao intentionally doubled the digitalis cardiac drops prescribed to her father.

clues.title: Crossword Margin Notation
clues.clueText: The handwriting on 14-Across matched Meera's penmanship, proving she was present in the flat.

clues.title: Smart Thermostat Override Log
clues.clueText: The thermostat was elevated to 34C at 20:30 PM to accelerate decomp and fabricate an alibi.

clues.title: Exterior Latch Forensics
clues.clueText: Flat 4B was locked from the exterior hallway with a duplicate key held only by Meera.

clues.title: Neighbor Dispatch Tape
clues.clueText: Neighbor Kavya's emergency call confirmed seeing Meera exit and lock the flat from outside.
